episodes.description:

One of the most powerful tactics in narcissistic abuse is creating false hope.

Cycles of abuse can convince survivors that self-awareness means change is just around the corner. A brief apology, a moment of vulnerability, or a promise to get help can make it seem like the relationship is finally turning a corner, even as the pattern continues.
